# Hobby Map

Discover 200+ hobbies matched to your personality, traits, and interests. Not a quiz — paste how an AI sees you and get embedding-based recommendations.

## What it does
- Paste text describing yourself (AI memory, interests, lifestyle)
- Get ranked hobby recommendations with multi-factor scoring
- Visualize matches across 6 radar axes: Commitment, Cost, Body, Environment, Social, Depth
- Compare hobbies side-by-side
- Explore the full hobby knowledge graph

## How matching works
- Vector similarity via Transformers.js (in-browser embeddings)
- Full-text search across hobby descriptions
- Knowledge graph traversal (concept → hobby edges)
- Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) merge
- Multi-factor scoring: Vector (0.28), FTS (0.30), Graph (0.14), Dimension (0.12), Outcome (0.10), Novelty (0.06), Barrier (0.10)

## Data Asset
- 223 hobbies with detailed attributes
- ~500 concepts (traits, interests, activities)
- ~6,500 edges connecting concepts to hobbies
- 15 raw dimensions normalized to 6 radar axes
- Hobby-to-personality-trait mapping

## Radar Axes
- Commitment: time investment required
- Cost: financial investment
- Body: physical activity level
- Environment: indoor/outdoor/social setting
- Social: interaction with others
- Depth: skill ceiling and mastery potential
